channel.title: GiveOwl – Giveaways & sweepstakes in Ireland
channel.description: Every listing links to the organizer’s official rules. GiveOwl never collects your entries.

item.title: Marketsz Major Sweepstake: win an iPhone 18 Pro – Marketsz Inc.
item.description: Prize: One iPhone 18 Pro (ARV $890) plus 1 year of Marketsz membership. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Free entry: create a free Marketsz account to receive ballots, or enter by the free email method described in the official rules. Open worldwide where legal, 18+. Ends December 31, 2026

item.title: Coca-Cola x Premier League prize draw (ROI & NI, no purchase) – Coca-Cola Ireland
item.description: Prize: 20 Premier League matchday packages (pair of tickets plus €750 towards travel, accommodation and food), Just Eat vouchers and jerseys; a mop-up draw for 10 vintage jerseys runs to 30 Nov. Deadline: October 30, 2026. Create an account on the Coca-Cola Ireland website (or scan a pack/display QR code), answer the question and pick your team. No purchase necessary, 18+, residents of the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland, up to 100 entries per person. The main draw (Premier League matchday packages, vouchers, jerseys) closes 09:00 on 30 Oct 2026; afterwards only a mop-up draw for 10 jerseys runs to 09:00 on 30 Nov 2026

item.title: Irish Times: win an overnight stay for two at Powerscourt Hotel Resort & Spa – The Irish Times (Powerscourt Hotel Resort & Spa)
item.description: Prize: An overnight stay for two with dinner in Sally Gap and breakfast at Powerscourt Hotel Resort & Spa, Co. Wicklow. Deadline: October 30, 2026. Answer the question on the Irish Times competition page with name, email and phone number (free, no purchase). 18+, Republic of Ireland residents, one entry per person. 16 Oct to 30 Oct 2026 (term 4 says mid-day on 30 Oct, term 5 says midnight, so enter early)

item.title: Deep RiverRock ViTAL lunch voucher instant win (ROI & NI) – Deep RiverRock (Coca-Cola Ireland)
item.description: Prize: 400 instant-win €/£15 vouchers (Boojum, plus Subway in NI or a takeaway-marketplace voucher in ROI). Deadline: October 31, 2026. Visit deepriverrock.ie/promo (or scan the QR code on a bottle or display) and submit name, email, mobile, country and age bracket. No purchase necessary, 18+, ROI and NI residents, one entry per day. 1 Sep to 31 Oct 2026

item.title: Spas.ie: win a spa day for two at Aghadoe Heights Hotel, Co. Kerry – Spas.ie
item.description: Prize: A spa day for two worth €250 at Aghadoe Heights Hotel & Spa (massage, iDome session, pool and jacuzzi, tea and scones). Deadline: November 1, 2026. Answer the multiple-choice question and enter name and email on spas.ie (free; marketing opt-ins are optional tick boxes). 18+, one entry per email address. The terms state no residency restriction. Closes 1 Nov 2026

item.title: Cadbury Giveaway Give-away (Republic of Ireland, no purchase) – Cadbury Ireland
item.description: Prize: Cash for people you nominate: main draw €25,000 shared among up to 5 nominees, plus instant wins of €50 to €5,000 (prizes go to the nominees, not the entrant). Deadline: November 4, 2026. Go to giveawaygiveaway.cadbury.ie, choose Ireland and enter full name, email and mobile number, then confirm with the one-time passcode sent by SMS. No purchase necessary in ROI (purchase is required in the UK only). 18+, residents of the Republic of Ireland (the promotion is also open to the UK), max 1 entry per day and 20 in the main period. Main period ends 23:59 GMT 4 Nov 2026; a wrap-up draw (€250) runs to 4 Apr 2027

item.title: Trampolines Ireland Christmas BERG go-kart draw – Trampolines Ireland
item.description: Prize: A BERG Buddy B.Orange go-kart (worth €299), delivered free. Deadline: November 5, 2026. Submit your email address on trampolinesireland.com (free, no purchase; joining the mailing list is optional). 18+, residents of the Republic of Ireland or Northern Ireland, one entry per person. Closes 5 Nov 2026, draw 6 Nov

item.title: Irish Times: win a myenergi Zappi GLO home EV charger with installation – The Irish Times (Nevo / myenergi)
item.description: Prize: A myenergi Zappi GLO 7kW home EV charger supplied and installed (valued at €1,000; winner pays a €300 installation contribution, possibly reclaimable via SEAI grant). Deadline: November 8, 2026. Answer the question on the Irish Times competition page with name, email and phone number (free, no purchase). 18+, Republic of Ireland residents, one entry per person. 23 Oct to midnight 8 Nov 2026. The winner needs off-street parking suitable for a wall-mounted charger, pays a €300 installation contribution and covers any extra works beyond the standard installation

item.title: National Book Tokens: win signed Sebastian Barry books, a Wrights of Howth hamper and a €50/£45 book token – National Book Tokens
item.description: Prize: A signed set of Sebastian Barry's novels incl. The Newer World, a Wrights of Howth 'Taste of Ireland' hamper and a €50/£45 National Book Token; 10 runners-up get a signed copy of The Newer World. Deadline: November 12, 2026. Enter via the form on the National Book Tokens competition page (free, no purchase, one entry per person). The organiser's page itself does not state the closing date, age or residency terms; third-party listings give 12 Nov 2026 and UK/Republic of Ireland residents, so check the terms on the entry page before entering

item.title: Win 2 tickets to Ireland v South Africa – Six Nations Rugby
item.description: Prize: Two tickets to Ireland v South Africa on 21 November 2026 at the Aviva Stadium, Dublin. Travel and accommodation not included. Republic of Ireland residents aged 18+.. Deadline: November 13, 2026. Submit the online competition form on the Six Nations website or app. One entry per person; no entry fee, no purchase necessary.

item.title: Chadwicks Autumn Sale garden equipment bundle draw – Chadwicks
item.description: Prize: A garden equipment bundle (contents not specified in the terms). Deadline: November 21, 2026. Answer a simple question on chadwicks.ie to enter (free). 18+, ordinarily resident in the Republic of Ireland, one entry per person. 17 Sep to 21 Nov 2026

item.title: Spas.ie: win an overnight spa break for two at Killashee Hotel, Co. Kildare – Spas.ie
item.description: Prize: An overnight spa break for two worth €460 at Killashee Hotel (stay, 50 min treatment each, cocktail, 3-course dinner, breakfast). Deadline: November 22, 2026. Answer the multiple-choice question and enter name and email on spas.ie (free; marketing opt-ins are optional tick boxes). 18+, one entry per email address. The terms state no residency restriction. Closes 22 Nov 2026

item.title: Currys Ireland Black Friday Perks prize draw (€500 gift card) – Currys Ireland
item.description: Prize: A €500 Currys gift card. Deadline: November 24, 2026. Complete the Currys Perks registration form and tick the box to be included (joining is free; you agree to receive Currys offers by email). 18+, Republic of Ireland only, one entry per person. 6 Oct to 24 Nov 2026, draw by 25 Nov

item.title: Draíocht Blanchardstown 25th Birthday: win two show tickets every month – Draíocht Blanchardstown
item.description: Prize: Two free tickets to a Draíocht show, drawn monthly (25 pairs per month in the first half of 2026). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Fill in Draíocht's online form (name, address, email, phone; free, no purchase); one entry stays in all remaining monthly draws. 18+, living in Leinster, one entry per household. Closes 30 Nov 2026

item.title: Primark Ireland €100 gift card prize draw – Primark Ireland
item.description: Prize: A €100 Primark gift card. Deadline: December 15, 2026. Enter your email and date of birth on Primark's online form (free, no purchase; entering means signing up to Primark emails). 18+, Republic of Ireland residents only (not Northern Ireland), one entry per person. 15 Sep to 15 Dec 2026

item.title: DEWALT UK & Ireland newsletter monthly prize draw (£600 tool bundle) – DEWALT (Stanley Black & Decker UK)
item.description: Prize: A DEWALT hand tool and storage bundle worth £600 RRP, drawn every month. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Subscribe to the DEWALT mailing list on dewalt.co.uk/newsletter (full name, email, trade); active subscribers are entered into each monthly draw (opting in to promotional emails is the entry route). No purchase necessary, one entry per person. 18+, residents of the UK (incl. Northern Ireland) or the Republic of Ireland. 1 Jan to 31 Dec 2026

item.title: Duracell Scan & Win 2026 – Real Madrid v Barcelona trip – Duracell
item.description: Prize: Six winners each get two prize bundles (Real Madrid v Barcelona 2027 match ticket, stadium tour, club jersey and scarf) plus £1,000/€ equivalent towards travel and accommodation. Open to UK and Republic of Ireland residents aged 18+. ROI entries must answer a skill question.. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Scan the QR code in store or go to duracellscanwin.com/en-ie, fill in your full name and email and correctly answer the skill question (“Name a player currently playing in La Liga”). Republic of Ireland residents 18+, up to 4 entries per person, no purchase required. 1 Jun – 31 Dec 2026

item.title: Visit Belfast 12 Days of Christmas Giveaway – Visit Belfast
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (last year: 12 daily prizes such as hotel stays, restaurant and shopping vouchers and event tickets in Belfast). Deadline: December 12, 2026. Last year you entered each daily prize on visitbelfast.com between 1 and 12 Dec (NI and ROI residents, 18+). Nothing is announced for 2026 yet

item.title: IMAGE Advent Calendar giveaway – IMAGE.ie
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (last year: a prize every day in December, e.g. hotel stays, beauty and vouchers, and a grand prize of all prizes on the last day). Deadline: December 24, 2026. Last year readers entered daily on image.ie through December. Nothing is announced for 2026 yet, and the entry steps were not readable on last year's page

item.title: Royal Collection Trust: Win a Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper – Royal Collection Trust
item.description: Prize: Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper (£150), posted worldwide. Deadline: December 1, 2026. Fill in your details on the Royal Collection Shop competition page; one entry per person/email, no purchase. Postage paid worldwide. Closes 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 GMT

item.title: The Nature Photography Contest 2026 – The Nature Photography Contest
item.description: Prize: €2,000 in cash prizes. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Upload nature photos on the contest website. Open internationally

item.title: 24 Days of DHL Virtual Advent Calendar 2026 – Deutsche Post DHL
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (2025: daily prize draws with prizes that changed each day). 2025: answer the day's question and fill in the entry form; each door stays open 48 hours. 18+
